riasec_survey.description: Build, repair, install, or maintain equipment, vehicles, tools, or facilities.
Work outdoors or use physical skill to complete practical tasks.
Use machines, tools, instruments, or technical equipment to solve problems.
Inspect, test, assemble, or operate mechanical or production systems.
Learn by doing hands-on projects rather than mainly reading or discussing.
Analyze data, evidence, symptoms, or patterns to find an answer.
Conduct experiments, research, or technical investigations.
Solve math, science, technology, or logic-based problems.
Use computers, lab tools, or technical systems to explore how things work.
Ask questions, compare options, and evaluate evidence before deciding.
Create visual art, design, music, writing, film, performance, or media.
Express ideas in original, imaginative, or unconventional ways.
Design presentations, layouts, images, spaces, or digital experiences.
Tell stories, perform, edit, produce, or communicate through creative work.
Work in flexible settings where originality and self-expression are valued.
Teach, tutor, coach, counsel, mentor, or advise other people.
Help people improve their health, learning, safety, or well-being.
Listen carefully and support people through challenges or decisions.
Work as part of a service team that supports students, clients, patients, or communities.
Explain information clearly so others can understand and use it.
Lead a team, project, business activity, event, or campaign.
Persuade, negotiate, sell, advocate, or influence decisions.
Set goals, organize resources, and motivate people to achieve results.
Take initiative in competitive, business, public-facing, or leadership settings.
Make decisions under pressure and communicate a clear plan of action.
Organize records, schedules, budgets, forms, data, or detailed procedures.
Use spreadsheets, databases, reports, or information systems accurately.
Follow established rules, standards, checklists, or quality-control processes.
Keep work orderly, complete, documented, and on time.
Review details carefully to prevent errors in transactions, files, or operations.
